t: None of the funds provided in this Act shall be available for training in any legal profession nor for the payment of tuition for training in such profession: Provided, That this limitation shall not apply to the off duty training of military personnel as prescribed by section 621 of this Act.

fable.w: This is an appropriations limitation barring the use of funds for legal-profession training, with an exception for off-duty training of military personnel. No party outside the federal government is consulted or given any role in a federal decision; the words "legal profession" and "training" do not create any comment, hearing, advisory, or suit mechanism.
fable.s: None of the funds provided in this Act shall be available for training in any legal profession nor for the payment of tuition for training in such profession

It merely defines what the money can and cannot be spent on.

There is no hearing, comment period, advisory body, rulemaking authority or right to sue.
